title: Build a fair recipient observation with private fields explicitly allowlisted
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_BENCHMARK.md, docs/PILOT100_READY.md, docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md and the task sourceRefs before editing. This is an independent leaf in the B001–B100 cohort, not an integration or completed feature claim. Implement only the owned source and tests, using the exact pinned API section in PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS. No imports from unmerged A/B modules, no manifests/barrels/App.tsx/shared task metadata edits and no new dependencies. Locally declare the contract's shared structural types; package engine/protocol production stays ES2022-only and pure, with no Firebase, browser, Node, UI, credentials, wall clock or global randomness. Use existing deterministic engine RNG only where the contract permits. Never turn a trusted verifier input into a claim of cryptographic verification. Unspecified rules remain explicit named decision-required results; no worker invents policies. Preserve existing T01–T10 API/tests. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests, then node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full. Return a handoff with paths, API, actual checks, benchmark receipt references and limitations. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, deployment, credential access, task-issue mutation or budget changes. Implement recipientObservation exactly as frozen in section B070 of docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md. Require the two terminal signals to agree: (phase === MATCH_END) must equal matchEnded, otherwise reject invalid-input before any projection. Before terminal Match End, reveal only ownRole; every player.revealedRole is null. Terminal views may reveal all roles. Permanent spectators always lose diagnostics, and active operators receive their own supplied diagnostic only during CREW_LOCKED/OPERATION_LOCKED. Treat input diagnostic as already recipient-scoped; this function does not select from omniscient raw history. Human and bot consumers get identical shapes.
acceptance: Pre-end serialized views never include another player’s role, and terminal views reveal exact assignments; either inconsistent phase/matchEnded combination rejects before projection.
A nonoperator or permanent spectator gets no diagnostic even when one was accidentally supplied; wrong phases also erase it.
Unknown/duplicate recipients and malformed player records fail; output is detached and contains no server seed, other diagnostics or raw audit.
The exported implementation matches the frozen local structural API, preserves legacy APIs, and changes only declared ownership; no unresolved rule is silently decided.

Scoped lint, typecheck and meaningful tests pass, followed by node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full; handoff records actual outcomes and receipt references without claiming App/provider integration.
